title: Vercel CLI deploy from apps/web fails: monorepo files not uploaded
observation: Running `vercel deploy` from apps/web uploads only that folder (163 files), so install fails with ERR_PNPM_NO_LOCKFILE and workspace packages are missing. Project rootDirectory is apps/web with sourceFilesOutsideRootDirectory=true, so CLI deploys must run from the repo root (a clean `git archive HEAD` snapshot works). Git integration is not connected yet: `vercel git connect` to coders-clan/wishscene failed because the Vercel GitHub App lacks org/repo access. Preview and Production currently share one Neon DATABASE_URL, contrary to DEPLOYMENT.md step 5.
